name: Arpeggio
description: A broken chord: the same figure stepped up or down the stave, one note at a time.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 18%; top: @pick(6%, 30%, 54%); width: 64%; height: 34%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(-16deg); transform: rotate(-16deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; top: 4%; width: 8%; height: 92%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
